verdict.rationale: The docs show that you can edit an agent in natural language, for example telling it "Update your instructions so you always do it this way" or "Turn this into a skill." They also show that an agent given a goal works out its own tool-calling sequence, which is prompt-driven workflow behavior rather than explicit workflow generation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating a complete workflow/flow from a single prompt, natural-language editing of workflow structure (nodes/steps/triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration.
